description: Defines the ClaimAttachment entity class for ORM mapping, representing attachments related to claims in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ClaimAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing claim attachments with properties like request ID, attachment ID, size, description, filename, attachment data, file type, user, and attached date.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the claim attachment.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID for the claim attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Returns the attachment data or resource.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type of the attachment.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user who attached the file.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user who attached the file.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the attachment was added.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the attachment was added.
